title: OGC Cartographic Symbology - Part 1: Core Model and Encodings - JSON Schema

marker.$comment: An expression, a MultiGraphic if it has elements, otherwise null or properties overriding those of the graphic (see graphic).

graphicArray.$comment: An array of graphics, or one element given by its index (see clause 16).

graphic.$comment: Checks a graphic against one definition: an expression, a MultiGraphic if it has elements, otherwise the graphic named by its type. Trying every kind of graphic instead, a validator could only report that none matched, not where the error is.

isExpressionObject.$comment: An object that is an expression rather than a graphic: an operation or function call, a property, a system identifier or a variable.

hasOp.$comment: An operation or a function call. Each expression definition checks such an object against one definition, selected by its op (see operation), rather than trying every kind of expression: with alternatives, the time a validator takes grows exponentially with the nesting depth.

operation.$comment: Checks an object with an op: an operator of this Part against its own definition, any other op as a function call.

booleanOperation.$comment: A boolean operator, a conditional expression or a function call.

numericOperation.$comment: An arithmetic or bitwise operator, a conditional expression or a function call.

characterOperation.$comment: A text function, a conditional expression or a function call.

conditionalOrFunctionCall.$comment: A conditional expression or a function call, the operations that can have any type.

argument.$comment: An expression of any type: an argument of a function call or of format, or an element of an array.

variableRef.$comment: A variable, as a JSON Pointer to the $variables of this style or of an included one (clause 16, /req/variables/expression). The member is matched by patternProperties so that tools resolving JSON references do not take it for one in this schema.
